es.ui.journal.title: Event log
es.star_engineer.title: A star engineer is looking for a job
es.star_engineer.text: A well-known processor designer has left their lab and is looking for a new place. They are ready to lead your research, but ask for a generous salary and a signing bonus.
es.star_engineer.cause: your company is talked about in the industry
es.university_grant.title: A university proposes a joint project
es.university_grant.text: A university lab is ready to take on part of your current research: it has the equipment and capable graduate students. In return it wants a grant.
es.university_grant.cause: your research has been noticed in academic circles
es.trade_show.title: Industry trade show
es.trade_show.text: An industry trade show is opening, and buyers and journalists will gather there. You can take a big booth, settle for a small one, or skip the show.
es.trade_show.cause: your processors are already on the market
es.tax_audit.title: Tax audit
es.tax_audit.text: The tax authority has announced an audit of your books. You can cooperate honestly and close the matter quickly, or hire lawyers: it is cheaper, but the audit may end in a heavy fine.
es.tax_audit.cause: your revenue has grown and the auditors have taken an interest
es.factory_strike.title: Strike at the fab
es.factory_strike.text: Fab workers demand higher wages and threaten to stop the lines. You can agree to a raise or refuse and live through the downtime.
es.factory_strike.cause: long shifts and rising prices in the area
es.patent_troll.title: Patent lawsuit
es.patent_troll.text: A small firm that makes no processors of its own accuses you of infringing its patent and demands compensation. You can settle out of court or go to trial.
es.patent_troll.cause: your processors sell well and have attracted patent hunters
es.patent_win.title: Court victory
es.patent_win.text: The court found the patent claim against you groundless. The industry is talking about your firmness.
es.patent_win.cause: you refused to settle and took the case to court
es.patent_win.mail.title: The court ruled in your favor
es.patent_win.mail.text: Your lawyers report that the court dismissed the patent claim. The case is closed, and the reputation of the company has grown.
es.patent_loss.title: Court defeat
es.patent_loss.text: The court sided with the plaintiff: you owe heavy damages and the legal costs.
es.patent_loss.cause: you refused to settle and lost the case
es.charity_gala.title: Charity gala
es.charity_gala.text: A foundation invites leading technology companies to a charity gala. A donation will strengthen the reputation of your company.
es.charity_gala.cause: your company is known in business circles
es.rival_scandal.title: Scandal at a competitor
es.rival_scandal.text: The press writes about trouble at a competitor: customer complaints, internal disputes, missed deliveries. Buyers have become warier of its processors.
es.rival_scandal.cause: the press watches market leaders especially closely
